data.spec: Four roles (not new personal assignments): Hardware owns apps/device/, module inventory, actual port mapping and firmware; agent/speech owns apps/server/src/agent/ and the speech adapter; procurement owns apps/server/src/procurement/ and supplier adapters (currently apps/server/src/integrations/supplier.ts); dashboard/integration owns apps/web/, core API/database (apps/server/src/app.ts, src/db/). Keep one integration owner. Coordinate shared packages/contracts changes before changing callers and regenerate JSON Schema with npm run contracts:export. Existing claimed tasks retain their owners.
